proposition: Tarjuma-yi Aḥādīs-i Mamzūj survives only in MS Majlis 10196 ff. 440b-41b, undated, with a seemingly defaced title and an abruptly truncated text, so the entry can give no date; the folio numbers exceed the 425 ff. the dissertation elsewhere assigns to the manuscript.

mediation.who: copyist(s) of MS Majlis 10196, as reported by Melvin-Koushki citing Ḥāʾirī's catalogue
